title: Log Processing and Classification Pipeline
description: Shared pipeline block to build log graphs, mask sensitive tokens, classify log severities, and unmask for readability. Steps 1-2 ([[build-log-graph]] then [[mask-segment]]) may be collapsed into the single fused action [[build-and-mask-log-graph]], which pipes the graph directly into the masker in one process and avoids writing an intermediate file; prefer the fused form when the intermediate graph is not needed on disk.

step_notes.build-log-graph: Emits the hierarchical graph to disk. If the intermediate graph is not needed, use [[build-and-mask-log-graph]] instead, which fuses this step with [[mask-segment]] via a pipe.
